pages.text: Dumps excess heat from a sealed room without letting air out.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: Opening the shutter exposes cooling fins. It makes no hole in your pressure wall and uses no fuel or O2.$(br2)In vacuum it radiates heat away.

pages.name: Heat Vent in a Wall
pages.text: Room on the floor side. Fins face out, under open sky.

pages.title: Placement
pages.text: Place it facing from the room outward. The back must touch the room.$(br2)The outdoor face needs $(bold)open sky straight up$(). Blocks, roofs or neighboring rooms stop it.

pages.title: Shutter
pages.text: Right-click toggles it. Redstone holds it open.$(br2)Grille light: $(bold)dim$() closed, $(bold)green$() venting, $(bold)amber$() waiting or blocked. Updates each second.

pages.title: Limits
pages.text: Heat only flows to a colder outside, so it can't cool below that.$(br2)Larger rooms cool slower; more vents cool faster.
It cools the air first while the walls keep warming it. A room without air loses wall heat instead.$(br2)The slats don't leak oxygen.

pages.title: Save Fuel
pages.text: Heaters fight an open vent. Lower the $(l:heating/thermostat)Thermostat$(/l) or stop heaters first. Core warmth still counts.$(br2)A $(l:heating/airlocks)Manual Vent Valve$(/l) dumps air. This doesn't.
Six iron, two copper and a lever. A full wall or roof block.
